title: Vuln Lab
summary: A self-hosted vulnerable-by-design lab environment for practicing exploit development in isolation.
description: A set of Docker Compose stacks reproducing common CVEs (deserialization bugs, SSRF, IDOR chains) for hands-on practice, with a small CTF-style scoring server on top.
challenges: Making the vulnerabilities realistic without accidentally shipping something exploitable outside the sandbox.
lessons: Writing the exploit before writing the fix produces much better detection rules later.
